The '''Trap Bobber''' is a [[tackle]] that helps [[fishing]] by causing the progress bar to decrease 33% slower (50% if the player is using an [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] with 2 Trap Bobbers) when the fish isn't within the fishing bar, reducing a fish's ability to escape.<ref name="progressbar" /> It can be  [[Crafting|crafted]] or purchased from [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|500}} after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 6]]. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{tprice|200}}. One Trap Bobber is the copper tier reward on the 13th of Winter for the [[SquidFest]] festival.
